scenario: [LTIM.4.1.1]: `Time - Time` is the exact `Duration` between them, and the largest, 2^63 - 1 ns, raises nothing. `P` holds the last instant (2^63 - 1 ns) as `a`, the epoch as `b`, and that largest `Duration` as `big`. Rule `largest` compares `p.a - p.b` with `p.big` and logs `true`. Rule `handler`, which logs any ComputationError, must not fire, so a range check that refuses the boundary fails here. PATH PINNED: the upper bound of libds's `Time - Time` arm in `rete/eval.c` and of the Mercury runtime's `ds.eval.ltim_1_1_5_sub`.
rules_ds:
schema P scope logical:
    id: Int key
    a: Time mutable
    b: Time mutable
    big: Duration mutable

rule largest:
    P p
->
    let same = (p.a - p.b) == p.big
    log info "{same}"

rule handler:
    ComputationError e
->
    log critical "{e.kind} {e.rule}"
